user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features; not used for training generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; not used to train models.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and GPT Actions; not for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for generative AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User

user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer

user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve products and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives for Amazonbot or noarchive robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences like Alexa without crawling for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives for Amzn-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated crawl of a randomly selected subset of the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow: / under User-agent: CCBot in robots.txt or join opt-out registry.
